release_notes:
Telegram alerts for catalog updates

You can now get a Telegram message whenever:
- A new service goes live
- A service goes offline
- A service's price changes (up or down)

Set it up under admincp Settings > Telegram: use your existing bot (or create one), add it to a Telegram channel or group as admin, then configure the new "Telegram Catalog Feed" section with that channel and which of the three alerts you want. Off until you turn it on.
